title: Coastal Pulse Digital
text:
Coastal Pulse Digital

notes:
Lead source: inbound signup + quickstart use. Product interest: Hosted API (streaming + function/tool-calling + structured JSON output).

Summary:
- Small marketing automation shop building an in-app support assistant + document summarization pipeline. Signed up, tried the quickstart Node streaming example.
- Primary ask: reliable JSON-mode streaming responses and function-calling for ticket creation. Low latency (<300ms per response token ideal for chat UI), cost-sensitive (tight monthly budget).

Technical problems reported (from their engineer):
- Streaming endpoint returns partial JSON chunks; JSON.parse fails mid-stream when aggregating tokens. Example: trailing comma inserted occasionally -> invalid JSON.
- Function call schema mismatch: declared function create_ticket expects {"ticket_id": "string", "priority": "string"}, model returned numeric ticket_id (12345) and omitted priority -> POC code's strict schema validation rejects it.
- SDK interaction: Node SDK sample for function-calling didn't trigger on their test prompt (expected function call), while curl request with identical payload did trigger — suspects streaming vs non-streaming difference.
- Tool-calling: structured output expected an object with nested arrays; model flattened arrays into comma-separated string in stream -> downstream parser breaks.

What we tried / internal notes:
- AE/SE: quick debug session 2026-03-03 (ff_20260303_8a3f). Collected both curl + Node logs. Repro steps attached in drive.
- SE replicated JSON.parse error on node-stream concat approach; hypothesis: returned tokens include control characters/newlines that break simple concat -> need robust streaming assembly with delimiter/frame detection or use SDK helper to accumulate JSON mode.
- Confirmed function schema enforcement in their validator is strict; recommend schema be tolerant for numbers vs strings or cast on our side; also adjust function definitions to use union-typed strings where possible.
- Temporary mitigation: have them switch to non-streaming function-calls for the ticket creation POC; works consistently. For chat UI, propose a streaming wrapper that buffers until balanced braces detected (heuristic) or use Redwood SDK structured-output helpers.

Timeline (recent):
- 2026-02-25: inbound signup, auto-onboarded, used quickstart.
- 2026-02-27: support form about streaming JSON errors -> INF-7892 created.
- 2026-03-03: 45m call (demo + logs) with Marco + Jamie; recorded (ff_20260303_8a3f).
- 2026-03-05: SE sent patched Node example + drive link.
- 2026-03-10: customer confirmed reproducible; asked for follow-up POC with streaming fix.

Quoted from customer: "We need the function call to be reliable for ticket ops — even if it means slightly higher latency, it's critical we don't lose structured fields."

Open items / next steps:
- SE to push curated Node streaming + structured-output sample to CoastalPulse drive folder by 2026-03-12 (done).
- Schedule 30m POC (screen share) week of 2026-03-16 to test client-side buffer heuristics + SDK helpers.
- Engineering doc: propose adding recommended server-side cast rules and example schemas for numeric vs string IDs.

Notes for AE/SDR: prioritize showing Hosted API ease-of-use; emphasize Redwood SDK helpers for structured JSON + function-calling and that Dedicated/Private not required for this workload. Keep close on cost sensitivity and provide cost estimate for projected monthly usage.

use_case_details:
PoC: in-app chat assistant streaming responses + function-calls to create support tickets in their system. Also using summarization for long docs. Need robust streaming assembly and strict structured output for ticket fields.

next_step:
Fix sample function-schema + streaming snippet in repo; follow-up POC call w/ SE week of 2026-03-16
